real_defects.issue: The non-UK resident finding quoted 2% of the price in pence (GBP 5,001.98 at a 250,099 price, GBP 6,000.01 at 300,000.50) while the bill, rounded down to whole pounds, rose by GBP 5,002 and GBP 6,000: a number on the page that disagreed with the tax shown. Fixed to quote the difference between the resident and non-resident tax; test over 3 buyer types x 5 prices.

L + 2(W+H) was reported and labelled as 'girth' on the result card, in every flag text and in two FAQ answers; UPS/FedEx define girth as 2W+2H and the 105/130/165 in limits as length plus girth, so a shipper's tape-measured girth disagreed with the page. Thresholds were applied to the right number. Fixed: engine returns girth (2W+2H) and lengthPlusGirth; flags and copy say length plus girth; test added.
